parents.texte: Abstract: The purpose of this RFP is to solicit responses from identified vendors to provide a bill generation solution based on the requirements identified in this document. Budgetary estimates are required. All information in connection with this RFP and project is strictly confidential. Only the official stakeholders of the project are entitled to consult this document or to intervene in the different phases of the project according to the limits of their scope of actions. The unlawful copying, distribution or use of this document is strictly prohibited without the written consent of Ooredoo Tunisia. The selected vendor must sign a Non-Disclosure Agreement ( NDA ) with Ooredoo Tunisia. In no case may this RFP constitute a commitment to contract by Ooredoo Tunisia.

Ooredoo Tunisia is a private telecommunications company in Tunisia. Set up with capital of 330 million Tunisian dinars, it was founded on 11 May 2002. Ooredoo Tunisia is part of the Ooredoo Group. it is the largest operator in Tunisia. Ooredoo Tunisia has also won, for the fourth consecutive year, the ‘ Best Customer Service – Telecommunications Sector ’ award for leveraging digital improvements to better serve customers In order to maintain its leading position in the telecommunications market and to fulfil customer’s requirements, Ooredoo Tunisia has decided to embark on a new solution for bill generation .

Bill Generation solution is a core component in Ooredoo Tunisia’s billing system. The role of this entity is to produce customer bills in PDF format. Facing the new customer requirements, Ooredoo Tunisia targets to renew the bill generation solution.
The current bill design did not change since years. For customer satisfaction, new design is requested.

In addition to the bill design, the technical solution needs to be optimized. The current bill generation solution has several limitations: • Slowness of document generation process • Complexity of design changes implementation: Any change requires a hardcoded update.

The purpose of this document is to solicit responses from identified vendors to provide and implement a Bill generation solution based on the requirements identified in this document. Ooredoo requires an industrialized IT solution (standard, preconfigured, fully automated, scalable and reliable solution) The solution must satisfy the envisaged business and technological values of this initiative as follows: 1. Functional area: • Modify the bill design to fit the business requirements • Have a rich and complete bill by supporting any future bill design changes • Faster time to market by provide full automation and full integration capabilities The attached document (2022_DSA_RFP Invoice Revamp.pdf) describe in details all the business requirements with examples of the target bill design 2. Technical Area: • Provide graphical interactive interface for bill design customization • Produce unified XML file for each bill • Insert bill details in Data Base tables (needed for statistics, …) • Produce bill in PDF Format • Send bills by email • Produce and send call details in CSV Format • Create a single PDF bill for several invoices (for splitted large accounts) • Provide web application for proposed solution management (Managing, running, monitoring, and reporting)

By satisfying the above goals and objectives, Ooredoo want to address the main pain points as follows: 1. Technical limitation and lack of flexibilities for extensions and evolutions of bill design 2. Performance issues a. PDF bill generation very slow (20k bills / Hour) b. High usage of server resources (CPU/Memory) 3. Splitted Large account bill generation Some large accounts are not billed in only one root customer, so they are splitted into several roots (large accounts) and later only one PDF invoice is manually created to be sent to the customer. Ooredoo request to automatically generate a single PDF bill for the splitted large account roots

The detailed target architecture will be agreed in the first phase of the project and could present some differences with the architecture presented here.

The detailed requirements for bill generation solution RFP are grouped in two domains as following: - Functional requirements - Technical requirements
The Functional requirements are outlined (but not limited to) in the attached file: “ 2022_DSA_RFP Invoice Revamp.pdf ”
The Technical requirements are outlined (but not limited to) in the attached file: “OT Bill Generation Solution Requirement v1.xls”

Selected Solution shall follow the Ooredoo Tunisia Process, Ooredoo will be providing all the required hardware to host the solution. Bidders will respond to the IT requirement in the SOC considering the above details and will be responsible to fill in the infra resources details based on the application requirement. These requirements will be used to allocate compute, network, and storage resource from Ooredoo Tunisia private cloud for the project. For the avoidance of doubt, Bidders will request required infra resources and Ooredoo Tunisia will be responsible to provide required hardware for the solution deployment. The required Infrastructure Cost will be part of TCO evaluation of the solution.

It is the bidder’s responsibility to deliver their proposal on, or before this deadline. Proposals received after the time specified will be considered late and may be disqualified at Ooredoo’ s discretion.

Bidders are responsible for making a careful examination of the scope of this RFP and to comply with all terms and requirements. Bidder must supply concise responses to the requirements within this document. References to external documents or Web sites will not be considered. Failure to address any of the requirements in this RFP could subject the Bidder’s proposal to rejection. It is very important that all bidders respond to all requirements and questions in the same order as identified in the respective Sections. Bidders who do not respond in the correct order of sections will be rejected. All bidder responses to this RFP become the property of Ooredoo. We reserve the right to use any information in this proposal to Ooredoo benefit. The RFP number must be identified in your proposal, and the proposal must be signed by an authorized official of your company. Ooredoo reserves the right to issue revisions in writing to this RFP at any time prior to the closing date.

Proposal submitted in response to this RFP should not be construed as an obligation on the part of Ooredoo to award a purchase order and/or contract. Proposals submitted in response to this RFP will be considered firm offers for a period of 30 days from bid close date. However, in the event Bidder reduces the price of any item or service provided in their initial bid responses, Bidder agrees to immediately pass these reductions on to Ooredoo by submitting a revised proposal. Bidder warrants that prices provided in your proposal are no greater than prices being charged any other customer for similar items, quantities and schedules with similar specifications.

Bidder should provide a brief overview and history of the company. Bidder should also describe the company organization and include specific data outlined below:  Bidder Company name and address  Contact name, title, address, email, phone  Headquarter address (if different)  Local sales address (if different)  Years in business under this name  Previous company name(s)  Years in business under previous name(s)

Bidder represents and warrants that:  It has full power and authority to execute, deliver and perform its obligations under this RFP entered into pursuant to its terms;  The Services will be provided in accordance with Good Industry Practice;  It will, throughout the Term, maintain an adequate number of personnel to perform the Services, and such personnel will be suitable, appropriately qualified, experienced and competent personnel;  It will ensure that turnover of personnel providing the Services will be limited to 5% (five per cent) in the first Contract Year, and 10% (ten per cent) in the second Contract Year;  Any Deliverables will comply with these relevant specifications and any other relevant requirements and shall be of satisfactory quality, free from design and other inherent defects and fit for their intended purpose;

Bidder should provide a financial performance summary including:  Financial information on your company, i.e. annual report.  Profit growth history for the past three years.  Average ratio of implementation services versus annuity business (for example, maintenance contracts).

Only legal persons who:  Justify the legal, technical and financial capacities required;  Having an existence of at least 5 years on the final date of submission;  Are in a regular tax situation for having subscribed their declarations, settled the sums due or in the absence of payment, constituted the guarantees deemed sufficient;  Are certified ISO 27001 is recommended. The following are not eligible to participate in this consultation:  Legal persons in compulsory liquidation;  Persons in receivership, unless special authorization has been issued by the competent judicial authority.

Bidders should provide: - Budgetary quote to implement the bill generation solution based on the requirements documented in this RFP. - Detailed, itemized pricing model with all applicable fees for support services, professional services, integration, and customization. - Any travel or other costs should be identified separately. - Offer must include 3 years maintenance support - Annual maintenance costs beyond the 3 years warranties for the 4th and 5th year should be identified as separate charges.
Bidder should provide the estimated three years total cost of ownership for the proposed solution and should provide details of calculation process.

Provide a brief overview of your professional and integration services organization while specifying the following topics:  The schedule of the transition process and the hand over  The project team that will take over the transition: team members should be suitable, appropriately qualified, experienced and competent personnel  Roles and responsibilities of proposed team members  Team members should be solution certified : provide copies of certifications  Onsite Vs Offsite activities  Skills transfer and hand over to Ooredoo Tunisia teams  Deliverables
Bidders to include a description for the methodology, tools used to manage the project, change control procedures, and common communication methods.

Bidders should provide training services and methods for delivering theoretical and practical trainings while taking into consideration following requirements:  Training should be provided for both engineering and support technical teams. At least 8 persons  Training and training materials must preferably be in French. It will also be Vendor responsibility everything needed for the availability of training environment. For the launching phase, the courses should be run in Ooredoo locals by the Supplier instructor.  Qualified and experienced instructors must give the lectures in the courses. The vendor should provide with a Training plan, Training material and execution for all the functional areas that are part of the scope. Schedule may be adjusted based Ooredoo plans. Ooredoo expects also list of suggested external training if applicable.

Bidders should clarify and describe the strategy and scope regarding support and maintenance of the bill generation solution while taking into consideration following:  Describe bidder role and responsibility and provide a RACI Matrix  Provide Escalation Matrix in case of unavailability  Provide details about support Software , Average response time SLA , contact channels (phone/email/portal/etc.).  Type of issue tracking system  Availability of on-site support and troubleshooting  Average response times for bug fixes and enhancement requests
